records.text: :tada: New signup: *Vantage Logistics* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: Account is 6 days old with early momentum: first_project reached day 0 and 1 invite sent, but no key_milestone and no customer reply to onboarding outreach [email:230e562c]. No tickets, so no blocker signal either. Starter plan, 8 days left; partial setup that stalls after project creation often doesn't self-complete.

draft.subject: Quick hand with your next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Felix,

Nice work getting Vantage Logistics started in Wrenfield -- you've created your first project and sent an invite already. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the next step is getting real work into that project so you can see how it holds up day to day.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your setup with you and answer anything that's come up. If email is easier, just reply here and I'll pick it up.

Best,
Chidi
